# Issue #5211 — [Bug] loader.js source mapping issue when loader.config with custom source map files in 0.55.1

[https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/5211](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/5211)

## Summary

The dangling loader source-map reference remains in current main: the AMD build copies loader.js unchanged without producing its referenced map. Route this packaging defect to integration; the supplied configuration and Vite diagnostic are sufficient to investigate.

## Change summary

Loading the local AMD loader through Vite reports ENOENT for its referenced min-maps/vs/loader.js.map.

## Best solution

Ensure the distributed AMD loader does not advertise an unavailable source map, while preserving loader configuration and runtime behavior. This is a bounded Monaco packaging correction, not a React-wrapper or VS Code editor-core defect.

## Proposed action

- **Triage action:** route-to-area
- **Item type:** bug
- **Reproduction:** source_reproducible
- **Evidence:** 5/6 Source-confirmed
- **Severity:** papercut

- **Confidence:** 0.88
- **Proposed comment:**

  > Thanks for the report. The AMD loader still contains a sourceMappingURL pointing to ../../min-maps/vs/loader.js.map, and the current build copies that loader without supplying the referenced map. This appears to be a Monaco packaging defect rather than an issue with your React configuration. The loader's source-map reference should be consistent with the files distributed in the package.

## Auto-fix candidate

- **Auto-fixable:** yes
- **Agent readiness:** implement
- **Rationale:** Source-confirmed, bounded packaging defect with an executable output-integrity check; no public behavior decision is needed.
- **Likely files:** `build/amd/src/loader.js`, `build/amd/vite.config.mjs`
- **Validation:** Run npm run build-monaco-editor, then a Node assertion over out/monaco-editor/{dev,min}/vs/loader.js requiring every external sourceMappingURL to resolve to an existing file. The current dangling reference must fail that assertion before the correction and pass afterward. Confirm the supplied local-loader Vite flow no longer logs the missing loader.js.map diagnostic.
- **Behavior:**

  > Using the packaged AMD loader with a local vs path must not cause Vite to report a missing loader.js.map because of an invalid distributed source-map reference. Both development and minified loader outputs must have valid external map references or no external map reference. Existing AMD loading and custom paths configuration must continue to work.
- **Trace:**

  > build/amd/src/loader.js:1368 contains the reported relative sourceMappingURL. In build/amd/vite.config.mjs, copy-loader reads that source file verbatim and emits loader.js for both output modes selected by build/amd/build.script.ts. The package assembly in build/build-monaco-editor.ts does not supply the referenced min-maps artifact. This establishes the packaging inconsistency without executing the build. Preserve runtime loader logic and path resolution; broader AMD modernization, ESM dependency maps, and worker localization are outside this report.

## Evidence

- **Reporter trigger:** https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/5211 supplies loader.config({ paths: { vs: 'node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs' } }) and a Vite 7.3.1 diagnostic resolving ../../min-maps/vs/loader.js.map from monaco-editor 0.55.1's loader.js.
- **Current source:** build/amd/src/loader.js:1368 still contains //# sourceMappingURL=../../min-maps/vs/loader.js.map. The copy-loader plugin in build/amd/vite.config.mjs emits this file unchanged into both dev/vs and min/vs.
- **Packaging boundary:** build/build-monaco-editor.ts assembles the ESM and AMD outputs and copies declarations, metadata, and notices; the inspected build scripts contain no producer or copy step for min-maps/vs/loader.js.map. The dangling reference is source-confirmed; no build or runtime reproduction was executed.
- **Canonical search:** Verified open related reports do not establish the same loader defect: https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/4712 concerns missing maps for ESM marked/dompurify assets; https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/3336 concerns a playground simpleWorker.nls.js map; https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/4495 concerns worker localization URL resolution.
